goal: Move storage- and file-IO-related responsibilities out of CompilationUnit into a dedicated helper class to remove direct dependencies on Files, Paths and CodeGenerationUtils from CompilationUnit.

inputs: CompilationUnit.setStorage(Path) overloads (the constructors that create Storage)
outputs: CompilationUnit: replace inner Storage with field of type CompilationUnitStorage and delegate calls
ops.details: Extract the inner static class Storage into a new top-level class com.github.javaparser.ast.CompilationUnitStorage. Move all methods and constructors that deal with file location, encoding and saving/reparsing (getPath, getEncoding, getFileName, getDirectory, getSourceRoot, save variants, reparse) into the new class. Replace the private field 'storage' in CompilationUnit with a field of type CompilationUnitStorage, update the setStorage(...) factory methods to instantiate CompilationUnitStorage and update getStorage() to return Optional.ofNullable(storage) as before. Update imports in both classes. The extraction isolates all usages of java.nio.file.Files, java.nio.file.Path (Paths.get), com.github.javaparser.utils.CodeGenerationUtils and related static util calls (subtractPaths/packageToPath) into the new class.

Add imports required by the extracted class (Files, Paths, Charset, Function, IOException, JavaParser, ParseResult, Providers.provider static usage) into CompilationUnitStorage. Remove those imports from CompilationUnit if they are no longer used there. Keep imports used elsewhere in CompilationUnit.

inputs: CompilationUnit methods that create or reference Storage: setStorage(Path), setStorage(Path, Charset), getStorage(), getPrimaryTypeName()
outputs: CompilationUnit updated to construct and delegate to CompilationUnitStorage
ops.details: Update in-class call sites so that where Storage was constructed (new Storage(this, path, charset)) the new class is constructed (new CompilationUnitStorage(this, path, charset)). Update any method references to Storage::getFileName used by getPrimaryTypeName to use the new class instance. Ensure getStorage() returns Optional.ofNullable(storage) where storage is of type CompilationUnitStorage.
